monitor.job: Read-only query training, SemanticOPT and BOLT→ORPO+FSBO health/progress/crash checks
monitor.mechanism: persistent local Python process with exclusive flock

limitations: Partial nonrandom task cohort; no full-test conclusion.
Only uncensored successful measured outcomes can improve incumbents.
New and old hybrids share exact BOLT30 measurements; standalone frozen FSBO and SemanticOPT share Bao49 instead.
At equal 200 new proposals, total counts are 230 hybrid versus 249 baselines; equal-total230 sensitivity uses 181 baseline proposals.
Storage, hosts, dates and seeds differ. RAM/cache change can affect timing. This is not a controlled causal retraining ablation.
SemanticOPT has only 200 measured proposals; no flat extrapolation used.
Task bootstrap describes this partial cohort; it is not uncertainty over training/evaluation seeds.
